verdict.rationale: Ghostwriter lets teams set tone and style with simple prompts. Voice Personas shape how the agent sounds and speaks across 59 languages and 60+ locales. Agent Checks and Simulations can verify behavior across scenarios to catch regressions. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the brand voice stays consistent across topics and text-channel languages (not just voice), any dedicated brand-voice or style-guide controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
